goal: Full 4-week Facebook organic workflow: location and brand foundation, calendar, captions, and visual brief. Prepare steps use social_campaign_calendar / caption_batch / visual_brief skills; align outputs to Facebook Page and Reels.

milestones.title: Facebook campaign brief
milestones.goal: Define the month window, theme, Facebook placements, and anchor dates.
milestones.data:
## Facebook campaign brief

**Start date:** <!-- YYYY-MM-DD -->
**End date:** <!-- YYYY-MM-DD (~4 weeks) -->
**Monthly theme:** <!-- e.g. Summer patio & cocktails -->
**Facebook placements:** <!-- Page Feed, Facebook Reels, Stories; optional Event or Group link -->
**Brand voice notes:** <!-- e.g. neighborly, chef-led -->
**Campaign objective:** <!-- e.g. Grow Page follows + weekend covers -->
**Key menu items or categories:** <!-- comma-separated -->
**Target audience:** <!-- e.g. nearby suburbs, families -->
**Post cadence:** <!-- e.g. 5 Feed, 3 Reels, daily Stories -->
**Page CTA focus:** <!-- Book / Call / Message / Shop -->
**Special events or holidays:** <!-- list or "none" -->
**Constraints:** <!-- no UGC without release, in-house photo only -->

passCriteria.requirement: Start date is specified (YYYY-MM-DD or clear equivalent).
End date is specified and is on or after the start date.
Monthly theme is stated.
At least one Facebook placement is listed (Feed, Reels, Stories, Event, or Group).
At least one special event or holiday in the window is noted, or the brief explicitly says "none".

milestones.title: Location Profile
milestones.goal: Operating snapshot from POS for Facebook local messaging and timing.

passCriteria.requirement: Peak periods or traffic pattern is documented.
Guest behavior section is present (when/how people order).
Positioning hints or implications for messaging are listed.

milestones.title: Brand Brief
milestones.goal: Pillars and proof points for Page About-style themes and Reels hooks.

passCriteria.requirement: 3–5 content pillars are defined and tied to categories or operating signals.
Tone guardrails are documented (3–5 bullets or equivalent).
At least one proof-oriented menu angle cites category mix or hero/trending items from the data.

milestones.title: 4-Week Facebook content calendar
milestones.goal: Prepare outputs a four-week calendar from Instagram-first skill text; edit Data so weeks and slots are explicit for Facebook (Feed vs Reels vs Stories) and your brief.

passCriteria.requirement: All four weeks (Week 1–4) are covered with planned slots.
Each week includes at least three post slots.
Content mix reflects weekly demand pattern where data supports it.
Each slot specifies format and intended Facebook surface (Feed, Facebook Reel, Story, or Carousel).

milestones.title: Facebook caption batch
milestones.goal: Generate captions via Prepare from the calendar; tune length and CTA for Facebook (links, comments, Page actions).

passCriteria.requirement: Every calendar slot has a corresponding caption block.
Each caption includes a hook, body, CTA, and tags or hashtags as appropriate for Facebook.
At least half of captions reference a clear Page or business CTA (visit, book, call, message, save).

milestones.title: Visual creative brief
milestones.goal: Shot lists and Reel hooks for Facebook-safe framing (Feed square/vertical, Reels 9:16, text-safe zones).

passCriteria.requirement: Each of four weeks has a shot list or equivalent visual plan.
A Reel or vertical video hook is specified for each week.
A Story or multi-slide sequence is outlined for each week.
